overall_reason: The deploy card's neutrals are clean, but its status marks are Tailwind 400 and 500 swatches set as gradients (#34d399 to #06b6d4, #a78bfa to #6366f1, #fbbf24 to #f97316) plus a #fecdd3 rose tile, with no source and two different hues for success.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE finds framework swatches as the status palette and T-PALETTE-ROLES finds five hue bands and two success colours; the untinted neutrals and the ink action keep it at 4.

findings.title: Colour has a source
findings.where: status icons and the Deploy button's check, 1440 and 375, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P32\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table lists 3 gradients with stops #34d399 to #06b6d4, #a78bfa to #6366f1 and #fbbf24 to #f97316, and a #fecdd3 fill; these are framework default swatches. The sweep's gradient detector flags the Deploy button blob (SLP-007).
findings.before: Framework 400 and 500 swatches as gradient status tiles
findings.after: A small state set (live, building, failed) with one flat colour each, sampled from the product's own palette
findings.why: Default swatches and gradients on small marks read as kit decoration rather than state.

findings.title: State colours keep their meaning
findings.where: 'Checkout redesign' row icon and the 'Deploy' button check, 1440, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P32\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The success check on the first row is a violet-to-indigo tile, while the success check on the Deploy button is emerald-to-cyan; the palette table spreads 0.12% chroma over five hue bands (270 to 300, 60 to 90, 0 to 30, 30 to 60, 180 to 210).
findings.before: Two hues for one success state; five hue bands for three states
findings.after: One hue per state, used the same way on the button and in the list
findings.why: When success is violet in one place and green in another, colour stops carrying meaning.

strengths: Text and surfaces are untinted greys (#1f1f1f ink, #8a8a8a and #9a9a9a meta) and the action is in near-black.
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
